{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for loyal, completed orders
loyal_completed = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = loyal_completed[loyal_completed['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
num_qa = len(qa_orders)

# Remove QA orders
loyal_completed_clean = loyal_completed[loyal_completed['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue
total_revenue = loyal_completed_clean['revenue_clean'].sum()
num_orders = len(loyal_completed_clean)
mean_revenue = total_revenue / num_orders

# Now print only the values that will be used in evidence
print(len(loyal_completed))  # Number of loyal, completed orders
print(num_qa)                # Number of QA orders
print(mean_revenue)          # Mean revenue after removing QA orders"}
